Scribus workflow for this project:

Prefer generating through the Go CLI, which writes out/scribus-job.json and invokes Scribus:

go run ./cmd/bookgen books/sample-book/

To run the committed adapter directly after a job file exists:

scribus -g -py scripts/scribus_generate.py books/sample-book books/sample-book/out/scribus-job.json

Expected outputs (stem from layout.json title, or the book directory name):
- books/sample-book/out/The Roast to San Rosario.sla
- books/sample-book/out/The Roast to San Rosario.pdf
